title: WebSocket server not scaling across instances
description: Users only receive real-time updates when connected to same server instance as sender. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Messages were broadcast in-process only. Added Redis pub/sub backplane for cross-instance fan-out and sticky sessions for connection affinity. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Malware uploaded through file upload feature
description: Security team detected an executable disguised as an image uploaded by a user. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Upload validation relied only on file extension. Added content-type sniffing via magic bytes, antivirus scanning before files are made available, and served user content from separate sandboxed domain. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: TLS handshake failures from legacy clients
description: Some enterprise customers' integrations failing with 'handshake failure' after load balancer security policy update. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: New policy disabled TLS 1.0/1.1 and older cipher suites. Identified affected customers via TLS logs, provided a temporary legacy endpoint with sunset date, and communicated migration requirements. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: DNS change not propagating
description: After migrating to new load balancer, some users still reach old servers 24 hours later. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Old record had TTL of 86400 seconds. Kept old endpoint serving and proxying traffic until TTL expired, and adopted practice of lowering TTL 48 hours before planned DNS migrations. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Build agents running out of disk
description: CI jobs failing randomly with 'No space left on device' on self-hosted build agents. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Docker layer cache and workspace directories never cleaned. Added post-job cleanup, scheduled docker system prune, and moved to ephemeral auto-scaling agents. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Redis memory full, evicting session data
description: Users randomly logged out. Redis shows evicted_keys increasing and memory at maxmemory. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Sessions and cache shared one Redis instance with allkeys-lru policy. Separated sessions into a dedicated instance with noeviction policy, set TTLs on all cache keys, and scaled memory.

title: Emails landing in spam for Gmail users
description: Gmail users report transactional emails in spam folder after domain change. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: New sending domain lacked DKIM alignment and had no DMARC policy. Configured DKIM signing for new domain, published DMARC, and registered with Gmail Postmaster tools to monitor reputation. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Excel export truncating leading zeros
description: Exported ZIP codes and product codes lose leading zeros when opened in Excel. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Values exported as plain CSV were interpreted as numbers by Excel. Added native XLSX export with text-formatted columns and documented CSV import guidance. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Bad release deployed to all regions at once
description: Release v5.1.3 with a configuration bug deployed simultaneously to all regions, causing global outage for 25 minutes. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Pipeline lacked progressive delivery. Implemented canary deployments starting with one region at 5% traffic, automated rollback on SLO breach, and feature flags for risky changes. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Availability zone outage took down service
description: catalog-api unavailable for 40 minutes during a cloud provider zonal outage in ap-southeast-1. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: All instances and the database were deployed in a single availability zone. Redesigned for multi-AZ with zone-redundant load balancer, database standby in another zone, and pod topology spread constraints.

title: Deployment pipeline failing on dependency install
description: All builds failing at npm install step with 'ETARGET no matching version found'. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Builds resolved floating version ranges and a transitive package was unpublished. Committed lockfile, switched to npm ci, and configured an internal package proxy to cache dependencies.

title: Storage costs rising from old object versions
description: Object storage bill growing despite stable data volume. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Bucket versioning enabled without lifecycle rules, keeping all noncurrent versions. Added lifecycle policy to transition noncurrent versions to archive tier after 30 days and expire after 180 days. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Search cluster out of heap memory
description: Search nodes crashing with OutOfMemoryError during peak traffic. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Aggregations on high-cardinality text fields loaded fielddata into heap. Switched aggregations to keyword fields with doc_values, set circuit breaker limits, and added dedicated coordinating nodes. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: CDN serving stale content after deploy
description: Users see old version of web app after release. Some users get mixed old HTML with new JS, causing errors. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: index.html was cached at CDN for 24 hours. Set Cache-Control no-cache for HTML, content-hashed filenames for static assets with long TTL, and added CDN purge step to deployment pipeline. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Deep links opening browser instead of app
description: Universal links from marketing emails open in Safari instead of the installed app. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: apple-app-site-association file was served with redirect and wrong content-type after CDN change. Served file directly with application/json, removed redirect, and verified with Apple's validation tool. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Failover took 8 minutes instead of seconds
description: During planned maintenance, primary database failover to standby in westeurope caused 8 minutes of downtime. Expected failover time under 60 seconds.
resolution: Application cached the database IP address at startup and ignored the DNS change. Configured connection strings to use the cluster endpoint, reduced DNS TTL, and set JVM DNS cache to 30 seconds. Added quarterly failover drills. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Uploaded files corrupted in storage
description: Some uploaded PDFs cannot be opened after download.
resolution: Multipart upload parts were assembled out of order on network retry. Switched to SDK managed multipart upload with checksum validation (MD5/CRC32C) on each part and on final object. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: NoSQL throttling errors on hot partition
description: order-service receiving ProvisionedThroughputExceeded / 429 errors although overall consumed capacity is below provisioned limit. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Partition key based on date caused all writes for the day to land on a single partition. Redesigned key to include a hashed suffix for write sharding and enabled adaptive capacity. Updated access patterns documentation. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Search cluster out of heap memory
description: Search nodes crashing with OutOfMemoryError during peak traffic.
resolution: Aggregations on high-cardinality text fields loaded fielddata into heap. Switched aggregations to keyword fields with doc_values, set circuit breaker limits, and added dedicated coordinating nodes. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Screen reader cannot navigate forms
description: Accessibility audit: form fields not announced correctly to screen reader users. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Inputs lacked associated labels and error messages were not linked. Added label/for associations, aria-describedby for errors, focus management, and automated accessibility tests (axe) in CI. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: TLS handshake failures from legacy clients
description: Some enterprise customers' integrations failing with 'handshake failure' after load balancer security policy update. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: New policy disabled TLS 1.0/1.1 and older cipher suites. Identified affected customers via TLS logs, provided a temporary legacy endpoint with sunset date, and communicated migration requirements. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Alert fatigue causing missed incidents
description: On-call engineers receiving 200+ alerts per week, mostly noise. A real disk alert was ignored. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Alerts were threshold-based on symptoms of minor fluctuations. Reworked alerting around SLOs and burn rates, removed non-actionable alerts, and added runbook links to every alert. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Logs missing timestamps in correct timezone
description: Incident investigation hampered because logs from different services use different timezones. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Services used host-local time with inconsistent formats. Standardized structured JSON logging with ISO-8601 UTC timestamps and correlation IDs across all services.

title: Outbound calls failing due to SNAT port exhaustion
description: billing-api intermittently failing to call third-party APIs with connection timeouts under load. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: All outbound traffic shared a few public IPs, exhausting SNAT ports. Deployed NAT gateway with multiple IPs, enabled HTTP connection pooling and reuse in the client. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Usage-based billing overcounting API calls
description: Customers disputing bills showing API usage 2x higher than their own logs. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Retried requests at the load balancer were metered twice. Moved metering to application layer after request completion, deduplicated by request ID, and issued credits to affected accounts. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Bulk user import failing for large files
description: Admins unable to import CSV with more than 5,000 users; request times out. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Import processed synchronously in request. Moved to background job with progress tracking, chunked processing, and per-row validation error report.

title: Large API responses timing out
description: GET /api/reports endpoint timing out after 30 seconds for large accounts.
resolution: Endpoint built entire result set in memory. Implemented streaming response, mandatory pagination, gzip compression, and async export job for very large datasets. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Unexpected 3x increase in cloud bill
description: Monthly cloud cost tripled compared to previous month. No new services launched intentionally.
resolution: Cost analysis found a test environment with large GPU instances left running and NAT gateway data processing from a misrouted backup job. Terminated idle resources, routed backups via private endpoint, and added budget alerts and auto-shutdown tags for non-prod. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Container memory limit causing OOMKills
description: Pods for billing-api restarting several times per hour with OOMKilled status. No obvious memory leak in application metrics. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: JVM was not container-aware and sized heap from host memory. Set -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75, aligned requests and limits, and added memory usage dashboards per pod. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Conditional Access blocking service principal
description: Automated deployment pipeline failing with AADSTS53003 when acquiring token. Pipeline worked until a new Conditional Access policy was enabled tenant-wide. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: New Conditional Access policy targeted 'All cloud apps' without excluding workload identities. Scoped policy to user identities only and created a separate workload identity policy restricting service principal sign-ins to known IP ranges.

title: Excel export truncating leading zeros
description: Exported ZIP codes and product codes lose leading zeros when opened in Excel. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Values exported as plain CSV were interpreted as numbers by Excel. Added native XLSX export with text-formatted columns and documented CSV import guidance. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Password reset links expired on arrival
description: Users clicking password reset links immediately receive 'link expired' message. Reset email arrives within seconds of request. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Corporate email security scanners were pre-fetching links, consuming the single-use token. Changed reset flow so the link opens a confirmation page and the token is consumed only on form submit. Added token reuse detection logging. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Latency spikes every hour on the hour
description: p99 latency for user-service spikes to 4 seconds at the top of every hour for about 2 minutes. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Hourly cron jobs from multiple teams all ran at :00, saturating shared database and cache. Spread schedules with jitter, moved heavy jobs to a dedicated worker pool, and added a shared scheduling calendar. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Android app crashes on devices with Android 14
description: Crash rate jumped to 8% after Android 14 rollout. Crash logs show SecurityException for foreground service type.
resolution: Android 14 requires declaring foregroundServiceType for foreground services. Added type declarations and required permissions to manifest, updated targetSdk, and released hotfix build via staged rollout. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: CDN serving stale content after deploy
description: Users see old version of web app after release. Some users get mixed old HTML with new JS, causing errors. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: index.html was cached at CDN for 24 hours. Set Cache-Control no-cache for HTML, content-hashed filenames for static assets with long TTL, and added CDN purge step to deployment pipeline. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Users seeing other users' data
description: Two customers reported seeing another customer's account dashboard briefly. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: CDN cached personalized API responses because Cache-Control was missing on authenticated endpoints. Purged CDN, set Cache-Control: private, no-store on authenticated responses, and added cache key review in security checklist. Notified affected users per policy. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Alerts not firing during outage
description: 45-minute outage of order-service detected by customers, not by monitoring. No alerts received. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Alert routed to a deactivated on-call channel after team reorganization, and alert relied on metric that stopped reporting (absence not detected). Fixed routing, added absent-data alerts, and introduced synthetic availability checks. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Battery drain complaints after update
description: App store reviews mention severe battery drain after release v5.1.3. Analytics show background location requested continuously. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: New feature used high-accuracy continuous location updates instead of significant-change monitoring. Switched to geofencing and significant location change APIs, and limited background refresh frequency. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: ETL job producing duplicate rows in warehouse
description: Daily revenue dashboard shows doubled figures for one day. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: ETL job was retried after partial failure and appended data again. Made loads idempotent using MERGE on natural keys and partition overwrite per load date. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: VM backups failing silently
description: Restore test revealed last successful VM backup was 23 days ago. Backup job dashboard showed green. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Backup agent failed after OS patch but job reported 'completed with warnings', which was treated as success. Updated agent, changed alerting to treat warnings as failures, and implemented monthly automated restore tests. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Environment variables mismatched between environments
description: Staging works but production fails with null reference error on startup. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: New required config key added to staging but not production. Introduced config schema validation at startup that fails fast with clear error, and centralized configuration management per environment. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Deep links opening browser instead of app
description: Universal links from marketing emails open in Safari instead of the installed app. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: apple-app-site-association file was served with redirect and wrong content-type after CDN change. Served file directly with application/json, removed redirect, and verified with Apple's validation tool. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: VPN tunnel to on-premises dropping
description: Site-to-site VPN between us-east-1 and data center disconnects several times per day, interrupting batch jobs. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: IKE phase 2 lifetime mismatch between cloud gateway and on-prem firewall caused failed rekeys. Aligned IPsec/IKE parameters, enabled dead peer detection, and deployed redundant tunnel in active-active mode.

title: 3D Secure challenge not displaying
description: European customers unable to complete checkout. 3DS authentication popup never appears and payment times out after 10 minutes.
resolution: Content Security Policy update blocked the issuer's challenge iframe. Added required frame-src domains to CSP and implemented fallback redirect flow. Added synthetic checkout test with 3DS test cards. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Webhook signature validation rejecting valid events
description: Incoming webhooks from payment provider rejected with 'invalid signature'.
resolution: Body-parsing middleware modified raw request body before signature verification. Preserved raw body for webhook route and used constant-time comparison for HMAC check. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Rollback failed due to database migration
description: Attempted rollback of order-service after errors, but previous version crashed due to new database schema.
resolution: Migration dropped a column the old version still used. Adopted expand-and-contract migration pattern, decoupled schema changes from app deploys, and added rollback compatibility test in pipeline. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Kerberos authentication failing on new servers
description: Newly provisioned application servers cannot authenticate users via Kerberos. Error 'KRB_AP_ERR_MODIFIED' in logs. Older servers in the same pool work fine.
resolution: New servers were missing SPN registration for the service account and DNS reverse lookup records. Registered SPNs, added PTR records, and added both steps to the server provisioning automation. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Log ingestion costs exploded
description: Logging platform costs increased 5x in one month. Ingestion volume at 2TB/day. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Debug logging left enabled in production for catalog-api after an incident. Reverted log level, implemented dynamic log levels, sampled high-volume info logs, and set daily ingestion caps with alerts. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Redis memory full, evicting session data
description: Users randomly logged out. Redis shows evicted_keys increasing and memory at maxmemory. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Sessions and cache shared one Redis instance with allkeys-lru policy. Separated sessions into a dedicated instance with noeviction policy, set TTLs on all cache keys, and scaled memory. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Kafka consumer lag growing continuously
description: Consumer group for shipping-service lagging by millions of messages. Downstream data hours behind. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Topic had 6 partitions limiting parallelism to 6 consumers, and consumers committed offsets synchronously per message. Increased partitions to 24, scaled consumers, and switched to batch processing with async commits.

title: Battery drain complaints after update
description: App store reviews mention severe battery drain after release v3.1. Analytics show background location requested continuously. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: New feature used high-accuracy continuous location updates instead of significant-change monitoring. Switched to geofencing and significant location change APIs, and limited background refresh frequency. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Logs missing timestamps in correct timezone
description: Incident investigation hampered because logs from different services use different timezones. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Services used host-local time with inconsistent formats. Standardized structured JSON logging with ISO-8601 UTC timestamps and correlation IDs across all services. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Currency conversion using stale exchange rates
description: International customers charged amounts based on exchange rates from two weeks ago. Finance noticed margin discrepancies.
resolution: Exchange rate fetch job failed silently after the provider rotated API credentials. Updated credentials in secrets vault, added staleness check that blocks checkout in affected currencies if rates are older than 24 hours, and alerting on job failure. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler not scaling
description: During traffic surge auth-gateway stayed at 2 replicas while CPU was at 100%. HPA shows '<unknown>' for current metrics. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Metrics server was not deployed after cluster upgrade, and pods lacked CPU requests. Reinstalled metrics-server, defined resource requests for all containers, and added a cluster readiness checklist after upgrades.

title: Cluster upgrade broke ingress
description: After upgrading Kubernetes to a new minor version, all external traffic returned 404. Ingress resources still present. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Upgrade removed a deprecated Ingress API version and the ingress controller version was incompatible. Upgraded ingress controller, migrated manifests to networking.k8s.io/v1 with ingressClassName, and added deprecated API scanning to CI.

title: Duplicate charges on customer cards
description: Several customers charged twice for a single order. Payment gateway dashboard shows two successful captures within seconds. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Webhook handler and synchronous checkout flow both triggered capture on authorization success. Made capture idempotent using gateway idempotency key and order state machine. Refunded affected customers. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Service unreachable after network policy change
description: Frontend pods unable to reach notification-service after security team applied default-deny network policies. Connection timeouts. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Default-deny policy blocked egress including DNS to kube-dns. Added explicit allow policies for DNS egress and frontend-to-backend traffic, and introduced policy testing in staging with a connectivity matrix.

title: Alerts not firing during outage
description: 45-minute outage of inventory-service detected by customers, not by monitoring. No alerts received. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Alert routed to a deactivated on-call channel after team reorganization, and alert relied on metric that stopped reporting (absence not detected). Fixed routing, added absent-data alerts, and introduced synthetic availability checks. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Object storage bucket publicly accessible
description: Security posture scan flagged a storage bucket containing customer exports as publicly readable. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Bucket policy had been modified for a temporary partner share and never reverted. Removed public access, enabled account-level block public access, switched partner sharing to time-limited signed URLs, and reviewed access logs. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Expired TLS certificate on internal service
description: Service-to-service calls to notification-service failing with certificate errors.
resolution: Internal certificates issued manually with 1-year validity. Deployed internal certificate automation (cert-manager) with short-lived certificates and automatic rotation. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Shared file system latency spikes
description: Applications using network file share experiencing multi-second I/O waits. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: File share burst credits exhausted due to sustained throughput. Moved to provisioned throughput tier, and moved temp files and caches to local SSD. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Migration locked production table for 20 minutes
description: Schema migration in release v4.0 added a column with default value and locked the orders table. All writes blocked; site effectively down during migration. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Migration rewrote the full table on the database engine version in use. Rolled forward by letting migration complete, then adopted online schema change tooling. Added CI check that flags blocking DDL on large tables. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Push notifications not received on iOS
description: iOS users stopped receiving push notifications. Android unaffected. Notification service logs show successful sends. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: APNs authentication certificate expired. Migrated from certificate-based to token-based (.p8) APNs authentication which does not expire annually. Added expiry monitoring for all signing credentials. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Notification emails sent to wrong users
description: A batch of order confirmation emails sent to incorrect recipients. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Race condition in batch job reused a shared mutable recipient object across threads. Refactored to immutable per-message payloads, added recipient/order consistency check before send, and notified affected users. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Page load slow due to large JavaScript bundle
description: Home page Largest Contentful Paint over 6 seconds on mobile. Lighthouse reports 4MB of JavaScript. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Entire charting and date libraries were bundled into the main chunk. Implemented route-based code splitting, replaced moment.js with a lighter library, and enabled tree shaking. Main bundle reduced to 380KB; LCP now 2.1s. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: SFTP partner file transfer failing
description: Daily file from logistics partner not being processed. SFTP job reports 'host key verification failed'. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Partner rotated SFTP server host key without notice. Verified new fingerprint with partner out-of-band, updated known_hosts, and added alerting for missing daily file by 06:00. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Push notifications not received on iOS
description: iOS users stopped receiving push notifications. Android unaffected. Notification service logs show successful sends. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: APNs authentication certificate expired. Migrated from certificate-based to token-based (.p8) APNs authentication which does not expire annually. Added expiry monitoring for all signing credentials. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Distributed traces missing spans
description: Traces for checkout requests show gaps; downstream service spans not linked. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Message queue consumers did not propagate trace context headers. Added W3C traceparent propagation in producer/consumer middleware via OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

title: New products not appearing in search
description: Products added in admin take hours to appear in search results. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Indexing was batch-driven every 6 hours. Implemented change data capture to stream product updates to search index within seconds and added indexing lag monitoring. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: API keys leaked in public repository
description: Security scanner alerted that production API keys for billing-api were committed to a public GitHub repository. Keys were exposed for approximately 6 hours. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Revoked and rotated all exposed keys immediately. Reviewed access logs for misuse and found none. Moved secrets to a managed secrets vault, enabled push protection and secret scanning on all repositories, and added pre-commit hooks. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Messages processed more than once
description: Customers receiving duplicate shipment notifications. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Consumer crashed after processing but before acknowledging, causing redelivery under at-least-once semantics. Made consumers idempotent using processed-message ID store and deduplication window.

title: Refunds stuck in pending state
description: Refunds initiated by support remain 'pending' for over a week. Gateway shows refunds as completed. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Gateway webhook for refund.succeeded events was not subscribed after migrating to a new webhook endpoint. Subscribed missing event types, backfilled refund statuses via gateway API, and added webhook event coverage test. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Firewall rule change blocked payment provider callbacks
description: Payment confirmation webhooks stopped arriving after network security group cleanup. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Cleanup removed allow rule for payment provider IP ranges. Restored rule using provider's published IP list via automation, and added synthetic webhook check every 5 minutes. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Service unreachable after network policy change
description: Frontend pods unable to reach shipping-service after security team applied default-deny network policies. Connection timeouts. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Default-deny policy blocked egress including DNS to kube-dns. Added explicit allow policies for DNS egress and frontend-to-backend traffic, and introduced policy testing in staging with a connectivity matrix. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Pipeline secrets exposed in build logs
description: Database connection string visible in plain text in CI logs accessible to all developers. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Script echoed environment variables in debug mode. Rotated credentials, masked secrets in pipeline settings, removed debug echo, and restricted log access. Added log scanning for secret patterns. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Container image vulnerability scan blocking release
description: Release blocked by security gate: base image has critical OpenSSL CVE.
resolution: Base image was pinned to an old tag. Rebuilt on patched minimal base image, set up automated base-image update PRs, and enabled nightly rescans of running images. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Streaming job checkpoint corruption
description: Spark structured streaming job fails to restart after cluster maintenance with checkpoint errors. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Code change altered stateful operator, making checkpoint incompatible. Restarted from new checkpoint with backfill from source offsets, and added checkpoint compatibility checks to deployment process. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Page load slow due to large JavaScript bundle
description: Home page Largest Contentful Paint over 6 seconds on mobile. Lighthouse reports 4MB of JavaScript. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Entire charting and date libraries were bundled into the main chunk. Implemented route-based code splitting, replaced moment.js with a lighter library, and enabled tree shaking. Main bundle reduced to 380KB; LCP now 2.1s. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: CORS errors blocking frontend API calls
description: New frontend deployment on app subdomain failing all API calls with CORS errors in browser console.
resolution: API CORS allow-list did not include new subdomain, and preflight responses were cached by CDN without Vary: Origin. Updated allow-list via configuration, added Vary header, and purged CDN cache. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Deadlocks in order processing during flash sale
description: Database reporting frequent deadlock errors in inventory-service during high-traffic sale event. Approximately 15% of checkout transactions failing and requiring retry. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Two code paths updated inventory and orders tables in opposite order. Standardized lock acquisition order across transactions, shortened transaction scope, and added automatic retry with jitter for deadlock victims.

title: Pods pending due to insufficient resources
description: New pods remain in Pending state with 'Insufficient cpu' events. Cluster autoscaler not adding nodes. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Node pool had reached its configured maximum node count and regional vCPU quota. Increased node pool max, requested quota increase, and right-sized over-provisioned CPU requests that were reserving 3x actual usage. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Duplicate records created on retry
description: Customers receiving duplicate orders. Database contains identical rows created milliseconds apart. Correlates with client timeouts and retries. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: API was not idempotent; client retries after timeout created new records. Introduced idempotency keys on create endpoints with a unique constraint, and returned the original response for repeated keys.

title: VPN tunnel to on-premises dropping
description: Site-to-site VPN between ap-southeast-1 and data center disconnects several times per day, interrupting batch jobs. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: IKE phase 2 lifetime mismatch between cloud gateway and on-prem firewall caused failed rekeys. Aligned IPsec/IKE parameters, enabled dead peer detection, and deployed redundant tunnel in active-active mode. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

resolution: Bucket policy had been modified for a temporary partner share and never reverted. Removed public access, enabled account-level block public access, switched partner sharing to time-limited signed URLs, and reviewed access logs. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Breaking change in public API broke integrations
description: Several partners report integration failures after release v4.0. Response field renamed from 'customer_id' to 'customerId'. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Field rename shipped without versioning. Restored old field alongside new one, introduced API versioning policy with deprecation headers, and added contract tests against published OpenAPI spec. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: MFA prompts appearing on every login
description: Users prompted for multi-factor authentication on every sign-in despite 'remember this device' being checked. Affects approximately 20% of users, mostly on Safari.
resolution: Browser privacy settings were blocking the third-party persistence cookie. Moved remember-device cookie to first-party domain and set SameSite=Lax. Updated user guidance for browsers with strict tracking prevention. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Cross-site scripting in user comments
description: Bug bounty report: script tags in comments execute in other users' browsers. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Comment rendering used innerHTML without sanitization. Switched to safe text rendering, added HTML sanitization library for rich text, and deployed strict Content Security Policy. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Offline sync conflicts overwriting user data
description: Field technicians losing notes entered offline. After reconnecting, server data overwrites local changes. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Sync used last-write-wins with device clock timestamps, which were often skewed. Implemented server-issued version vectors with field-level merge and conflict UI for manual resolution. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Rollback failed due to database migration
description: Attempted rollback of billing-api after errors, but previous version crashed due to new database schema. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Migration dropped a column the old version still used. Adopted expand-and-contract migration pattern, decoupled schema changes from app deploys, and added rollback compatibility test in pipeline. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Nodes running out of disk space
description: Kubernetes nodes in eastus2 reporting DiskPressure, pods being evicted. Mostly affects long-running nodes. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Unused container images and container logs accumulated on nodes. Configured kubelet image garbage collection thresholds, log rotation, and moved to ephemeral OS disks with node auto-upgrade to recycle nodes regularly.

description: Admins unable to import CSV with more than 5,000 users; request times out. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Import processed synchronously in request. Moved to background job with progress tracking, chunked processing, and per-row validation error report. Knowledge base article created for support team.

description: During traffic surge shipping-service stayed at 2 replicas while CPU was at 100%. HPA shows '<unknown>' for current metrics. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Metrics server was not deployed after cluster upgrade, and pods lacked CPU requests. Reinstalled metrics-server, defined resource requests for all containers, and added a cluster readiness checklist after upgrades. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Read replica lag causing stale data
description: Users see outdated account balances immediately after making changes. Read replica in us-east-1 showing replication lag of up to 45 seconds. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Heavy analytics queries were running on the same replica serving application reads, starving the replication apply thread. Moved analytics to a dedicated replica, routed read-after-write requests to primary, and added replica lag alerts at 5 seconds. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Database storage full in us-central1
description: Managed database instance entered read-only mode. Application unable to write new records. Storage usage at 100%. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Transaction log growth from a stalled logical replication slot consumed all storage. Dropped the orphaned replication slot, enabled storage autoscaling, and added alerts for replication slot lag and free storage below 20%. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: ImagePullBackOff in production cluster
description: Deployments failing with ImagePullBackOff. Error shows 'unauthorized: authentication required' when pulling from private registry. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Registry pull secret expired after token rotation policy change. Switched to workload/managed identity based registry authentication (no static secret) and added alert for image pull failures. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: CRM sync creating duplicate contacts
description: Salesforce integration creating duplicate contact records nightly. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Matching used email exact-match, but email case differed between systems. Normalized emails to lowercase, used external ID field for upsert, and ran a one-time merge of duplicates. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Connection storms after application restart
description: Every deployment causes database CPU to spike to 100% for several minutes and login failures for users. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: All 40 pods opened full connection pools simultaneously and warmed caches with heavy queries. Introduced a connection proxy (PgBouncer), staggered rollout with maxSurge limits, and lazy cache warming. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Timezone bug after daylight saving change
description: Scheduled tasks ran one hour late after daylight saving transition; some ran twice. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Schedules stored in local time without timezone info. Stored schedules in UTC with explicit IANA timezone, and handled DST gaps/overlaps explicitly in scheduler. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: ImagePullBackOff in production cluster
description: Deployments failing with ImagePullBackOff. Error shows 'unauthorized: authentication required' when pulling from private registry.
resolution: Registry pull secret expired after token rotation policy change. Switched to workload/managed identity based registry authentication (no static secret) and added alert for image pull failures. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: Availability zone outage took down service
description: shipping-service unavailable for 40 minutes during a cloud provider zonal outage in eastus2. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: All instances and the database were deployed in a single availability zone. Redesigned for multi-AZ with zone-redundant load balancer, database standby in another zone, and pod topology spread constraints. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Dashboard numbers differ from source system
description: Finance reports BI dashboard revenue 3% lower than ERP totals. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Dashboard filtered on order date in UTC while ERP used local business date, and excluded refunded-then-recharged orders. Aligned business date definition and documented metric definitions in a semantic layer. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: CRM sync creating duplicate contacts
description: Salesforce integration creating duplicate contact records nightly. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Matching used email exact-match, but email case differed between systems. Normalized emails to lowercase, used external ID field for upsert, and ran a one-time merge of duplicates. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: OAuth token refresh failing for notification-service clients
description: Clients integrating with notification-service receive 401 Unauthorized roughly 60 minutes after login. Refresh token requests return 'invalid_grant'. Started after identity provider upgrade to v3.4.2. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Refresh token rotation was enabled on the IdP, but clients were reusing the old refresh token. Updated client SDK to persist the newly issued refresh token on every refresh. Added grace period of 30 seconds for concurrent refresh requests. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Search relevance degraded after reindex
description: Users complaining search results are less relevant; exact product names no longer ranked first. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: New index mapping removed keyword sub-field and custom analyzer. Restored mapping with keyword field boosting, and added search relevance regression tests with a golden query set.

resolution: Dashboard filtered on order date in UTC while ERP used local business date, and excluded refunded-then-recharged orders. Aligned business date definition and documented metric definitions in a semantic layer. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: SCIM provisioning creating duplicate users
description: Users provisioned from identity provider appear twice in the application. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: SCIM endpoint matched on userName case-sensitively while IdP changed casing. Implemented case-insensitive matching on externalId and userName, merged duplicates. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Flaky integration tests blocking releases
description: About 30% of pipeline runs fail on integration tests that pass when re-run. Release velocity dropped. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Tests shared a database and depended on execution order and wall-clock time. Isolated test data per test run using containers, mocked time, and quarantined flaky tests with tracking dashboard. Knowledge base article created for support team.

resolution: SCIM endpoint matched on userName case-sensitively while IdP changed casing. Implemented case-insensitive matching on externalId and userName, merged duplicates. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Serverless function cold starts causing timeouts
description: API endpoints backed by serverless functions intermittently take 8-10 seconds, exceeding client timeout. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Cold starts with large deployment package and VPC attachment. Reduced package size, enabled provisioned concurrency for latency-sensitive functions, and lazy-loaded SDK clients. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: Emails landing in spam for Gmail users
description: Gmail users report transactional emails in spam folder after domain change. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: New sending domain lacked DKIM alignment and had no DMARC policy. Configured DKIM signing for new domain, published DMARC, and registered with Gmail Postmaster tools to monitor reputation. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Autoscaling group launching instances that fail health checks
description: New instances in eastus2 terminated shortly after launch. Scaling activity loops continuously. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: Launch template referenced an AMI whose user-data script depended on a package repository that had moved. Pinned repository URL, baked dependencies into a golden image via image pipeline, and increased health check grace period. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: LDAP sync dropping users from groups
description: Users intermittently losing group memberships and therefore access to features. Nightly LDAP sync job logs show partial results with no errors. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: LDAP queries were hitting the directory server's 1000-entry page size limit without paging. Implemented paged results control (RFC 2696) in the sync job. Added reconciliation report comparing group counts before and after sync. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Translations missing after release
description: German and French users see English text in new settings page. Raised by an enterprise customer through account manager.
resolution: New strings not extracted to translation files before release. Added string extraction to build, translation completeness check, and fallback logging for missing keys. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: VM backups failing silently
description: Restore test revealed last successful VM backup was 23 days ago. Backup job dashboard showed green. Noticed during on-call shift handover.
resolution: Backup agent failed after OS patch but job reported 'completed with warnings', which was treated as success. Updated agent, changed alerting to treat warnings as failures, and implemented monthly automated restore tests. Shared learnings in engineering all-hands.

title: Cloud quota limit blocking deployment
description: Deployment to us-central1 failing with 'QuotaExceeded' for public IP addresses.
resolution: Subscription hit regional public IP quota due to orphaned IPs from deleted VMs. Cleaned up unattached IPs, requested quota increase, and added a weekly orphaned resource cleanup automation. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Invoice totals off by one cent
description: Customers reporting invoice totals that differ by $0.01 from line item sum. Finance reconciliation failing. Detected by synthetic monitoring.
resolution: Tax was calculated per line item using floating-point arithmetic and rounded inconsistently. Switched to decimal arithmetic, defined rounding at invoice level per tax jurisdiction rules, and added reconciliation unit tests.

title: Password reset links expired on arrival
description: Users clicking password reset links immediately receive 'link expired' message. Reset email arrives within seconds of request.
resolution: Corporate email security scanners were pre-fetching links, consuming the single-use token. Changed reset flow so the link opens a confirmation page and the token is consumed only on form submit. Added token reuse detection logging. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: API keys leaked in public repository
description: Security scanner alerted that production API keys for checkout-service were committed to a public GitHub repository. Keys were exposed for approximately 6 hours. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Revoked and rotated all exposed keys immediately. Reviewed access logs for misuse and found none. Moved secrets to a managed secrets vault, enabled push protection and secret scanning on all repositories, and added pre-commit hooks. Runbook updated with diagnosis and remediation steps.

title: SMS verification codes not delivered in some countries
description: Users in certain countries never receive SMS one-time codes. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: SMS provider required sender ID registration for those countries. Registered sender IDs, added fallback provider routing, and offered voice call and authenticator app alternatives. Added regression test to prevent recurrence.

title: Subscription renewals not charged
description: Monthly subscription renewals silently skipped for some customers. Customers retain access without payment. Billing job reports success. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: Renewal job filtered on next_billing_date in UTC while dates were stored in local timezone, skipping customers near midnight boundaries. Normalized all billing dates to UTC and ran catch-up billing with customer notification.

title: Currency conversion using stale exchange rates
description: International customers charged amounts based on exchange rates from two weeks ago. Finance noticed margin discrepancies. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Exchange rate fetch job failed silently after the provider rotated API credentials. Updated credentials in secrets vault, added staleness check that blocks checkout in affected currencies if rates are older than 24 hours, and alerting on job failure. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: High CPU on notification-service after release v5.0
description: CPU utilization jumped from 30% to 95% after deploying v5.0. Latency p99 increased from 200ms to 2.5s. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Profiling showed a regex with catastrophic backtracking added in input validation. Rewrote the pattern to be linear, added regex timeout, and introduced performance benchmarks in CI for hot paths. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Serverless function hitting concurrency limit
description: Queue-triggered functions throttled; queue backlog growing to 200k messages. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Account-level concurrency limit shared with another workload. Set reserved concurrency per function, requested limit increase, and configured batch size and max concurrency on event source mapping. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: SSL certificate expired on public website
description: Customers seeing 'Your connection is not private' warnings. Certificate for main domain expired overnight. Flagged during weekly operations review.
resolution: Certificate auto-renewal failed because DNS validation record was deleted during DNS cleanup. Renewed certificate, restored validation record, moved to managed certificates with auto-renewal, and added 30/14/7-day expiry alerts. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

title: CORS errors blocking frontend API calls
description: New frontend deployment on app subdomain failing all API calls with CORS errors in browser console. First reported on the community forum.
resolution: API CORS allow-list did not include new subdomain, and preflight responses were cached by CDN without Vary: Origin. Updated allow-list via configuration, added Vary header, and purged CDN cache. Postmortem published and action items tracked.

resolution: LDAP queries were hitting the directory server's 1000-entry page size limit without paging. Implemented paged results control (RFC 2696) in the sync job. Added reconciliation report comparing group counts before and after sync. Knowledge base article created for support team.

title: Android app crashes on devices with Android 14
description: Crash rate jumped to 8% after Android 14 rollout. Crash logs show SecurityException for foreground service type. Reported by the support team via escalation.
resolution: Android 14 requires declaring foregroundServiceType for foreground services. Added type declarations and required permissions to manifest, updated targetSdk, and released hotfix build via staged rollout. Knowledge base article created for support team.
